name: asset-migration-studio
description: Asset Migration Studio - agentic Maximo/SAP to IFS Cloud migration

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
